title: Overlay\_dx - Automating forecasting evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2609.24586v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Traditional evaluation metrics provides numerical values but often lack comprehensibility, hindering effective differentiation of model performances. Our work addresses this challenge by introducing overlay\_dx, a novel evaluation metric measuring the performance of time series prediction models. Overlay\_dx is a visual metric that represents the percentage of predictions falling within a confidence interval around actual values. Additionally, once evaluation results are plotted, overlay\_dx computes the area under the overlay curve, providing a quantitative measure of alignment between predicted and actual values across different thresholds and predictions. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that our approach offers a unified evaluation framework that combines both visual and numerical assessments, enabling improved model comparison and providing valuable insights for further research and optimization efforts in time series p

translated_abstract: 传统评估指标虽然能够提供数值结果，但往往缺乏可理解性，阻碍了对模型性能的有效区分。我们的工作通过引入 overlay_dx 来应对这一挑战，这是一种用于衡量时间序列预测模型性能的新型评估指标。Overlay_dx 是一种可视化指标，表示预测值落在实际值周围置信区间内的百分比。此外，在绘制评估结果后，overlay_dx 会计算叠加曲线下的面积，从而提供在不同阈值和预测条件下预测值与实际值之间对齐程度的量化度量。通过大量实验，我们证明了我们的方法提供了一个统一的评估框架，将可视化评估与数值评估相结合，能够改进模型比较，并为时间序列预测领域的进一步研究和优化工作提供有价值的见解。
tldr: 提出 overlay_dx，一种结合可视化与数值评估的新型时间序列预测模型评估指标，通过计算预测值落在实际值置信区间内的百分比以及叠加曲线下面积，实现更直观、更统一的模型性能比较。
en_tdlr: We propose overlay_dx, a novel evaluation metric for time series forecasting models that combines visual and numerical assessment by measuring the percentage of predictions within confidence intervals around actual values and computing the area under the overlay curve, enabling more interpretable and unified model comparison.
